role: Graduate civil engineer or civil design support - expression of interest (Notting Hill)
subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil design support, Notting Hill, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am writing with a speculative enquiry about graduate or junior civil design and documentation support at DPM Consulting Group in Notting Hill. I could not find a dated junior vacancy on your site today, so I wanted to reach your published consulting inbox directly.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office and site work across Melbourne.

Your land-development civil design and documentation work for residential and industrial projects is the consulting start I am seeking. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment, so I am looking for mentoring on drawings and delivery.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
